verdict.rationale: AngelList documents the pieces of this workflow: 409A valuation requests under Equity > Valuations, board consents generated and signed on-platform, and Equity Blocks that boards pre-approve so standard grants skip individual approvals. Grants are e-signed with automatic cap table updates, and recipients accept them by e-signature. However, nothing shows the 409A value automatically setting the option strike price, or these steps running as one connected workflow. AngelList's own update FAQ also describes helping customers move to J.P. Morgan and Pulley, which casts doubt on the equity product's continued availability. Missing for 10: explicit linkage of the 409A fair market value to the grant strike price, documentation of a single end-to-end hire-to-grant flow, independent or hands-on corroboration, and clarity on whether equity management is still offered.
